title: Luxurious Low Fat Thai Squid Curry
description: A rich and gooey Thai curry featuring squid, made with a quick-fix flambe method, low in fat for a healthier option.

ingredients.name: squid
ingredients.notes: cleaned and cut into bite-sized pieces

instructions: Heat the oil in a large pan over medium heat.
Add the curry paste and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the squid and cook for 2 minutes, until it starts to brown.
Add the coconut milk, fish sauce, lime juice, and brown sugar, and stir to combine.
Bring the mixture to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes, until the squid is cooked through.
Use a kitchen torch to flambe the curry, caramelizing the top layer.
Stir in the chopped Thai basil.
Serve the curry hot, garnished with additional basil if desired.
